en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Wahab Bin Abd Rabbihi who said,

‘I saw Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> picking teeth, so I looked at him<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to pick teeth and he<sup>asws</sup> was of the aromatic mouth’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ibn Mahbub from Wahab ibn ‘Abd Rabbibhi who has said the following:
“I once saw abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, using toothpicks and I looked at him (the Imam). He (the Imam) said, ‘The Messenger of Allah would use a toothpick; it cleanses the mouth.’”
